issues.title: [ui-audit] tui-app-fixture blocks on read in non-interactive harness
issues.problem: tui-demo.sh uses read -r twice; harness subprocess blocks 30s then TimeoutExpired uncaught — run_audit.py exit 1 with no fail row; blocks key_nav_help journey
evidence: data/latest-tui-ux-run/ux-audit.json: tui-app-fixture status fail, harness_error TimeoutExpired
ux-harness/adapters/tui.py:33 subprocess.run timeout=30, no stdin injection
printf '\n\n' | tui-demo.sh exits 0 — flow completable when stdin piped
remediation_checklist: [ ] File: ux-harness/adapters/tui.py — catch TimeoutExpired; pipe stdin for non-TTY
[ ] File: ux-harness/fixtures/tui-demo.sh — LI_TUI_NONINTERACTIVE=1 or read from /dev/null
[ ] Test: python3 ux-harness/run_audit.py --target tui-app-fixture --mode ux exits 0 with fail row
[ ] Acceptance: harness never crashes uncaught on interactive fixtures

evidence: data/latest-tui-ux-run/ux-audit.json: journeys: [] on both TUI targets
adapters/tui.py run_tui_ux: no journey step runner
remediation_checklist: [ ] File: ux-harness/adapters/tui.py — execute journey steps with stdin injection (h, q, tab)
[ ] File: ux-harness/fixtures/tui-demo.sh — interpret h key for help overlay
[ ] Test: ux-audit.json reports key_nav_help journey with step results
[ ] Acceptance: friction_points derived from journey failures not fixture exit alone
